entities.name: Sedouris
entities.description: A city on Corondor that was sacked and torn apart.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Dark planeswalker who summoned a Cosmic Horror to sack Sedouris and installed her walking citadel there.

entities.name: Cosmic Horror
entities.description: Powerful creature summoned to sack Sedouris.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Held Sedouris under siege for five years.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Summoned by Carth at the site of Sedouris.
